shellCommands.command: sed -i 's/{ describe, it, expect, before, after }/{ describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll }/; s/^before(async () => {/beforeAll(async () => {/; s/^after(async () => {/afterAll(async () => {/' test/store.test.js && npm test 2>&1 | tail -8

PORT=3123 node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Piranesi","author":"Susanna Clarke","notes":"dreamlike and quiet"}'; echo
ID=$(curl -s localhost:3123/api/books | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)).books?.[0]?.id ?? JSON.parse("")')
curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3123/api/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"finished"}'; echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "detail page: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/$ID
curl -s localhost:3123/api/books/$ID; echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home: %{http_code}, css: " localhost:3123/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}, bad create: " localhost:3123/style.css
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST localhost:3123/api/books -d '{"author":"nobody"}'
kill %1

PORT=3123 node server.js & sleep 1
ID=$(curl -s localhost:3123/api/books | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0))[0].id')
curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3123/api/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"finished"}'; echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "share link page: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/$ID
curl -s localhost:3123/api/books/$ID; echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "path traversal blocked: %{http_code}\n" --path-as-is "localhost:3123/../server.js"
kill %1; ls books.json && cat books.json
